lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical lines; spacing is relatively uniform with a slight compression observed in the mid-torso region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The most posterior lines (positions 10 and 11) are fragmented into short, dash-like segments near the upper haunch.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of approximately 6 high-contrast white spots located on the lateral posterior haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots align horizontally across the mid-thigh to form a semi-linear geometric pattern.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white spots on the muzzle/cheek region and a single white transverse band across the lower neck.
